title: Undirected Graph Facade for NetworkX Parity
description: Implement `UndirectedGraph`, the NetworkX `Graph` parity facade, in mathematical/graph/normal/undirected/rs/lib.rs. It wraps mathematical_graph::Storage<Normal, Undirected> and exposes construction, node/edge ops, queries, transforms (copy/subgraph/edge_subgraph/to_directed/clear), attribute get/set, self-loop helpers, and path helpers, plus GraphView/AttrView/EdgeWeights delegation. Wave 1b of the NetworkX-3.6.1-parity effort; owns exactly this one file, only depends on mathematical_graph (core, frozen) for this pass — other pre-declared crate deps in Cargo.toml are empty stubs left untouched for later waves.
summary:
EN 1993: Renamed part_1_7 aluminium module to part_1_5_plated with EN 1993-1-5 plated buckling (plate reduction factor, effective width, local buckling stress); part_4 now delegates to part_1_5_plated. Added check_steel_member_from_fem() using fem_core (simply supported beam), check_full_steel_member() orchestrating parts 1-1 through 6 (core, shear, fire, fatigue, bolts, bridge, silo, pile driving/compression, stainless, plated). Expanded Document with satellite check fields. evaluate() now calls check_full_steel_member. Replaced weak steel_member_e2e with numeric utilization assertions; added full_steel_member, fem, and plated buckling tests. All 11 tests pass.

EN 1998: Fixed check_building_seismic to compute base shear via base_shear_from_design_kn(s_d, mass_t) instead of discarding s_d. Added check_full_seismic() covering parts 2 (bridge isolation + bearing), 3 (silo SRSS), 4 (tower), 5 (dam), 6 (foundation bearing/sliding). Expanded Document with satellite fields. evaluate() now calls check_full_seismic. Added building_seismic_base_shear_uses_sd numeric test. All 8 tests pass.
